description: Public whole-building energy benchmarks. Site EUI in kBtu/ft2-year. p50 values are national medians (EPA ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager national median table) unless noted; the generic commercial fallback is the CBECS 2018 average. p20/p80 are screening bands (roughly +/-35% around the median) for guardrail coloring, not published percentiles.
